result.summary: The page is mostly well-structured with consistent card layouts, but there are a few minor visual issues: truncated text on horizontally scrolling cards and low-contrast placeholder text in the search bar.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' is cut off at the right edge ('Trattoria Piccol...'), which is expected in a horizontal scroll but the truncation makes the name hard to read and there is no visual affordance indicating more content is available to scroll.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle scroll indicator (e.g., partial peek of next card plus fade or pagination dots) and ensure truncated names wrap or ellipsize cleanly.

issues.description: Search field placeholder text 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is light gray on a light gray background, giving low contrast that may be difficult for low-vision users to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text color or the field background to meet WCAG contrast guidelines.

issues.description: The 'Pizza' category chip is cut off at the right edge of the filter row, with no fade or affordance suggesting horizontal scrolling.
issues.suggestion: Add a right-edge fade gradient or partial chip visibility to hint that the category list scrolls horizontally.
